As “small island digital states”, #SIDS 🏝️ are leveraging AI, IoT, and remote sensing to optimize energy planning, predict climate risks, and integrate energy with water, food, and transport systems:

🌊 Pacific SIDS are using open data platforms and digital assessments to enhance energy planning and financing transparency
☀️ Caribbean SIDS are integrating AI and IoT into energy systems to improve smart grid management
🏝️ AIS SIDS are upskilling and reskilling workforces needed for a resilient and inclusive energy transition that can empower women, youth and entrepreneurs through digital.

SIDS are also advancing the use of data through initiatives like the UNDP Data Platform for SIDS, a key instrument for supporting SIDS in following up on the Antigua and Barbuda Agenda for SIDS, including a compiled database of over 4000 country-level indicators, a GIS portal with geospatial datasets from over 80 research studies and databases, a customizable version of the MVI, and novel machine learning models for filling data gaps.💡👉 https://lnkd.in/ecnQjT_j

In close collaboration with Alliance of Small Island States (AOSIS) , UNDP is supporting SIDS in strengthening regulatory frameworks, unlocking financing, and building local technical capacity to harness digital innovation for accelerating their #EnergyRevolution. ⚡️📌 Read more on the strategy 👉 http://go.undp.org/34Q
